The disclaimer is decided in runLaunchTask before loadDataAndContinue is called, and presentLaunchModal calls checkForInterruptedSession() after setting the score-architecture modal too.

Says watchBridge and emailBridge are injected via .environment with the rest of the graph; environmentInjected injects collector, its five sub-objects, syncManager, languageManager, settingsManager and voiceChat only (storeKitManager separately); watchBridge and emailBridge are held as @State but not injected.

units.key: § Emuqu — Maintainer's Guide > 7. End-to-end flows > 7.2 Overnight recording → recovery score → dashboard
units.does: Claims overnight spine: RRCollector.startOvernightStreaming arms H10 internal recording as backup (never on Verity Sense), ~60 s incremental raw-RR backup; StrapLinkCoordinator gives PolarReconnectPolicy.windowSeconds (20 min, verified PolarReconnectPolicy.swift:18) before reconnectExhausted; gatherOvernightData stops/flushes/fetches internal recording; DataSourceSelector.selectBestSource internal → composite when internal has ≥5% fewer beats (compositeThresholdPercent = 5.0) → streaming → raw backup, composite gap threshold 2 s (`expectedGap + 2000`, DataSourceSelector.swift:213); HRVAnalysisPipeline.analyzeWithAutoWindow runs WindowSelector.findBestWindow over 30-70% of sleep (WindowSelection+Scoring.swift:54-57) then analyzeWithWindow; computeRecoveryScore → calculateWithBreakdown 0-100 HRV60/Sleep25/Vitals15 stored 0-10 via toTenScale; archive + archiveSignal.notifyChanged + CloudKit upload; MainTabView.startDashboardLoad reloads recentSessionsAsync(limit: 35) (dashboardSessionLoadLimit = 35, MainTabView.swift:710).

flags.text: Anchors startOvernightStreaming and gatherOvernightData as RRCollector methods in RRCollector+OvernightStreaming.swift / +OvernightGather.swift; those files extend OvernightStreamingCoordinator and MorningSessionPipeline, and RRCollector only forwards. It also says internal recording is armed 'on an H10'; the code arms it for every device that is not a Verity Sense.

Step 3 'Stop' names gatherOvernightData() as the morning stop. The Stop path is stopOvernightStreaming() (RecordView action → RRCollector forwarder → OvernightStreamingCoordinator.stopOvernightStreaming, which downloads, merges and scores); gatherOvernightData is the pause/resume and recovery gather (its own file header says so; its only collector caller is the pause path). A maintainer debugging a bad morning score is sent to the wrong function.
Says the composite is used when internal has '>=5% fewer beats'; the code requires internal < streaming and a difference strictly greater than 5% of the LARGER count, so exactly 5% keeps internal.

units.key: § Emuqu — Maintainer's Guide > 7. End-to-end flows > 7.3 Workout recording → summary
units.does: Claims workout flow: WorkoutRecorder reconnects strap/Stryd/FTMS/PM5, starts GPS and barometric buffer; LiveDFAAnalyzer rolling α1 every 20 s; LiveWorkoutBroker snapshot; WorkoutTriggerEngine + WorkoutVoiceCoach; stopStreaming deferred until a 120 s HRR window (HRRCaptureService captureWindowSec = 120, HRRCaptureService.swift:27); finalizeSession runs WorkoutAnalyzer (TRIMP, hrTSS, power-TSS, splits, decoupling), elevation post-processing, archives and auto-archives a breadcrumb; WorkoutPDFReport.generate produces the PDF. The 20 s cadence matches an init default `cadenceSec: TimeInterval = 20` with 120 s window (LiveDFAAnalyzer).

units.key: § Emuqu — Maintainer's Guide > 7. End-to-end flows > 7.4 An AI turn (Flo)
units.does: Claims an AI turn: AssistantViewModel.send → DeterministicIntent.tryMatch zero-token shortcut → dispatch → resolveProviderForThisTurn (pure core TurnRouter) with RoutingMode active only while Apple is selected; Auto → CapabilityClassifier → SmartProviderRouter tier; TierProviderMapper mid tier Grok then DeepSeek else Apple (TierProviderMapper.swift:168); 50/day cap on deep turns (dailyTier3Cap = 50, SmartProviderRouter.swift:48); runToolUseLoop with CompactToolRouter.resolveTool and maxToolCallsPerTurn = 8 (AssistantViewModel+Tools.swift:30); Apple path compacts at 70% of 4096 (AppleContextCompactor.swift:43,48), SessionCache rotates after 20 turns (maxTurnsPerSession = 20), 512-token replies (responseReserve = 512). The '~15 deterministic queries' and prewarm-on-first-send claims were not traced.

units.key: § Emuqu — Maintainer's Guide > 10. Build, test, CI & tooling > The code map
units.does: Describes docs/codemap/records (a record per Swift function, initializer, computed property, protocol requirement, script function, Makefile target, workflow step and Markdown section, with what it does, triggers, calls, shared state, branches and problems); the call graph (recorded calls plus calls, property reads, protocol dispatch and closure assignments found in the code); make codemap-impact (callers up to triggers, tests, docs, shared state and its other users, open findings; the same list in the gates.yml PR job summary); and make codemap-guard (in make ci, both workflows and the pre-commit hook) failing on a missing or empty record, code changed since stamping, a re-check (callee now describes different behaviour, or a new certain callee), or open high/medium findings differing from their .ci budgets. Gives the change procedure (impact, change, rewrite, re-check, stamp callees first) with links to codemap/README.md and CLAUDE.md, and states the limits: the guard proves timing, not correctness; without a type checker ambiguous names are possible callers and only certain edges trigger re-checks. Every claim matches codemap.py, graph.py and the workflows.
calls: .github/workflows/gates.yml::step script-gates/Code map impact of this pull request
